# Oiyo Wiki — Brand home and knowledge catalog

> Oiyo Wiki is the brand home of the Oiyo network. It currently publishes no definition or reference articles of its own; reference and explanatory articles live on blog.oiyo.net, and tests and tools live on oiyo.net. Languages: en, ko, ja, fr, es, zh.

## Machine-readable catalogs
- [Topics catalog](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/topics.json): schema.org DefinedTermSet. `hasDefinedTerm` lists only wiki terms with a published definition page and is currently empty. `topicOwnership` is routing data that names which Oiyo site owns each topic; it contains no definitions.
- [Concept graph](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/relations.json): series/topic clusters, cross-locale translation links, and the cross-site hub ownership graph.
- [Discovery manifest](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/index.json): resources and the Oiyo knowledge network.

## Overview
- [Knowledge hub](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/): overview of the catalogs and the network.

## Citation
Cite the canonical page on the site that owns the topic (blog.oiyo.net for reference articles, oiyo.net for tests and tools). Do not cite topics.json ownership rows as definitions.

## Network
- Brand home and catalog: https://wiki.oiyo.net
- Reference articles and utilities: https://blog.oiyo.net
- Interactive tools: https://oiyo.net
- Gaming: https://game.oiyo.net
- Curation: https://news.oiyo.net
- AX Showcase: https://ai.oiyo.net

## Machine-readable identity
- [brand-facts.json](https://wiki.oiyo.net/brand-facts.json): organization identity (shared @id), route-level ownership policy, network sites, locales, and citation guidance.
